title: Pure Jurrac
summary: Jurrac cards only, with generic staples; the page's wider Dinosaur engine is left out. The 2025 cards are the core of the deck, turning self-destruction and Level arithmetic into massive field presence.

summary.title: Starters
points: Jurrac Stego: Destroys one card you control, sends a Dinosaur from the Deck to the GY, and summons Jurrac monsters from your hand or Deck whose total Levels equal the sent monster's Level, ignoring summoning conditions.
Jurrac Megalo: Special Summons itself next to another Dinosaur, discards two cards to draw two, and mills a Jurrac when destroyed.
Jurrac Volcano: Field Spell that destroys a Dinosaur to summon a Jurrac from the Deck, replacing lost monsters and protecting your board.

summary.title: Opening: Stego into Titano
steps: Normal Summon Jurrac Stego, activate its effect to target and destroy Jurrac Volcano or another card you control, and send Level 9 Jurrac Titano from Deck to GY.
Stego summons Jurrac monsters whose Levels total 9 from your hand or Deck, such as Jurrac Herra (Level 6) plus Jurrac Brachis (Level 3 Tuner), or Jurrac Titano itself directly ignoring conditions.
Tune Level 6 Jurrac Herra and Level 3 Tuner Jurrac Brachis with Level 1 Tuner Jurrac Aeolo or tune Stego and Herra into Level 10 Jurrac Astero.

summary.title: Bosses & Disruption
points: Jurrac Astero: Level 10 Synchro that Sets a Jurrac Spell/Trap directly from the Deck on summon, negates an opponent's Special Summon, and quick-tags into Jurrac Meteor on their turn.
Jurrac Meteor: Destroys every card on the field when Synchro Summoned and revives a Tuner from your GY.
Jurrac Titano: 3000 ATK untargetable Dinosaur boss that cannot be targeted by Traps or monster effects and gains ATK by banishing Jurracs from the GY.
Evolzar Dolkka: Rank 4 Dinosaur Xyz made with Stego and Guaiba to negate monster effects repeatedly.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Jurrac Volcano: Destroys a Dinosaur you control to Special Summon a Jurrac with a different name from the Deck, and shields Jurrac monsters from destruction while you control a Synchro Monster.
Jurrac Impact: High-impact board wipe searchable by Astero that clears all cards on the field if you control a Dinosaur with 2500 or more ATK.
